briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 accelerate AGI timeline amid US-China chip tensions

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push model releases while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Compute bottlenecks and safety concerns dominate discussions as multi-agent systems proliferate.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 featuring improved constitutional AI. Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3, Meta open-sources Llama 4, and xAI deploys Grok-3.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act amendments target autonomous agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins 1.4nm production for AI accelerators. Microsoft and Google announce $40B+ data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge become mandatory for critical infrastructure before 2028?
